title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — November 21, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.3)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B5.1 (Peaked November 21, 2026 at 09:17 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 353 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)

No days off when you're a star. ⭐🌎☀️

Several active regions and broad coronal-hole features are visible today, with no obvious large outward coronal structure.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 211 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
